findings.reason: The contradiction rule leaves the recorded planOneShot value unspecified. The goal names both the design-review stop and a resumed run keeping its recorded flags, so a resume could revive a stop or give a plain interactive run depending on what was written. That is an incorrect or ambiguous result in a goal-named path, not a style point.

Nothing tests the new autonomous=true default or the opt-out mapping, and reverting the default passes both suites. The default is the goal's headline behavior, so this is a missing test for a goal-named behavior. The fix is an assertion in an existing test file, which adds no new script.
